Promo Info: TOP4 prize for Championship 2024 Cycle 1 -Grand Asia Open- Regional Preliminaries
Upper Text: [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less. If no opponent's Digimon was deleted by this effect, you may digivolve this Digimon into a level 6 Digimon card with [Gallantmon] in its name in your hand for the digivolution cost. When this Digimon would digivolve with this effect, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
